# drawbridge — AI companion / roleplay chat domains
#
# These are the "virtual girlfriend/boyfriend" and unfiltered-roleplay services.
# They are not covered by mainstream adult or social blocklists, which is why
# this list is maintained here and pinned by SHA-256 in dist/policy.json.
#
# General-purpose assistants (chatgpt.com, claude.ai, gemini.google.com) are
# deliberately not listed — add them to `blocked_domains` in the policy if you
# want them blocked too.
#
# Grok is the exception, and is here rather than left to that rule: it ships a
# companion mode with deliberately unfiltered personas, which is the thing this
# list is for. Its home inside X is already covered — x.com is on the social
# list — so what these entries add is the standalone app and site.

character.ai
aidungeon.io
aidungeon.com
play.aidungeon.io

# European Parent Safety Catalogue — added with policy 21.
#
# anima.ai was REMOVED in the same edit. It is a venture studio for
# nature-inspired innovation and has nothing to do with the companion app;
# the Anima in the catalogue is myanima.ai, which is what replaced it. The
# package (anima.virtual.ai.robot.friend) is blocked either way, so the wrong
# entry blocked an unrelated business without ever blocking the app.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Added 2026-08-16, after the owner found the Play Store side of this category
# wide open: Cycle AI, Rosytalk, StarGirl and Trend AI were all installable on
# a locked phone. The package ids are the substance of that fix and live in
# `blocked_packages`; these are the handful of matching web fronts.
#
# **Only domains whose page said what they were.** `fantasia.ai` did not
# respond and `cycleai.com` served a generic "Home", and both names are ordinary
# enough to belong to something else entirely — the same trap that put anima.ai
# on this list once and then took it off again. Their apps are blocked by id,
# which is the half that was actually missing.
rosytalk.eu
sayloai.com
dopple.ai
evaapp.ai
kindroid.org
# Behind Cloudflare, so the page could not be read; the name is distinctive
# enough and the app id com.hiwaifu.app is confirmed.
hiwaifu.com
